name: Tempester n°53: note durations up to 768 (w1 bit 15 = x4)
explanation: A note event kept its duration in w1 bits 7-0 (units of 4 ticks, 0 = free slot): [routine] returned w1 & 0xff, [routine] wrote the low byte, [routine] capped the held time at 1023 ticks (255 units), the Beat Events editor at min(beat length / 4, 255) (n°5); everything after storage holds 14 bits or more ([routine] end tick (len & 0x3fff) << 2, queue word +0x18, Timer 4 voice countdown, MIDI note-off counter). w1 bit 15 (no live writer; [routine] copies it to queue +0x14, which nothing reads) now means x4: stored (b15, L) is the duration L << (2 * b15); a value v is written as (0, v) when v <= 255, else (1, min(v >> 2, 255)), rounded down. The accessor ([address], jump to 0x9d07ac00) returns the full duration to its 21 callers (18 zero tests, unchanged; [routine]; the editor; the event display); the writer ([address]-[address], call of 0x9d07ac14) keeps the velocity (bits 14-8) and encodes; recording caps the held time at 3071 ticks (767 units, stored 764); the editor ([address], wrapper 0x9d07ac3c) has the maximum min(beat length / 4, 768) and steps by 4 at 256 and above; n°5's words are not touched. Format unchanged otherwise: the serializer copies w1 whole. Beats without bit 15 play as before; the original OS plays a x4 note for its low byte only (a quarter of its length). Timer 4 cost: +4 instructions per accessor call (at most 42 a tick). Docs/analyses/bugs-open-2026-11.md §18; bit 15 decision in Docs/analyses/feature-automation.md.

edits.why: jal 0x9d07ac3c ; was "jal [routine]" (a0 = current duration, set in the delay slot)
andi a3,s0,0xffff ; was "andi a3,s0,0xff": the full new duration to [routine]
j 0x9d07ac00 ; was "andi v0,v0,0xff": the duration with bit 15 (x4) applied
addiu sp,sp,0x18 ; the frame release of the original epilogue, in the jump delay slot (was "jr ra")
andi s1,a3,0xffff ; was "andi s1,a3,0xff" (delay slot of jal [routine]): the full duration asked
jal 0x9d07ac14 ; was "li v1,-0x100": v1 = encoded duration (b15 | L), s1 only read
andi a0,v0,0x7f00 ; was "and a0,v0,v1": keep the velocity only (bit 15 belongs to the duration now)
or v0,a0,v1 ; was "or v0,a0,s1": velocity | encoded duration
ext a3,a3,0x2,0xa ; was "ext a3,a3,2,8": duration = held ticks >> 2 on 10 bits, encoded by [routine]
bne t0,zero,0x9d07ac34 ; v <= 255: stored as is, bit 15 clear
lw t0,0x13c(s4) ; edited beat (s4 = the screen's context at the only call site, [address])
lw t0,0x1c(t0) ; beat length in ticks
ext a2,t0,0x2,0x10 ; length / 4, as the original maximum
sll a1,a1,0x2 ; 256 and above: step 4 (the representable durations)
